projectDescription: Nexxus is a full-featured unblocked gaming platform and web OS featuring a curated arcade of 177+ HTML5 and Flash games, a Gemini-powered AI chat assistant, a class schedule/bell tracker, a community wallpaper engine with moderation, and a real-time visitor telemetry console for administrators.
keyFeatures: Curated arcade library of 177+ unblocked HTML5 and Flash games with search, filtering by category, sorting, favorites, and recently played history
Gemini AI-powered chat assistant with multiple model fallback support, persistent chat history, and starter prompts
Class schedule and live bell tracker with customizable class blocks, weekday assignments, and countdown timers
Community wallpaper engine with user submissions, admin moderation (approve/reject/delete), and a public wallpaper store
Real-time visitor telemetry console with live session tracking, IP/device/OS detection, heartbeat polling, and kick controls
Game proxy server that fetches and locally caches games from the MonkeyGG2 GitLab repository with CORS support
Cinematic animated intro sequence with session-based display (once per tab session)
Black-and-white monochrome UI design with keyboard shortcuts (/, Escape, Shift+O) and fullscreen support
publicApiSurface: POST /api/telemetry/open — Register a new visitor session
POST /api/telemetry/heartbeat — Update session activity and check for kick signals
POST /api/telemetry/close — Close an active visitor session
GET /api/telemetry/sessions — Retrieve all recorded sessions with aggregate stats
POST /api/telemetry/kick — Kick visitor(s) back to the home page
GET /api/chat/status — Get active Gemini AI configuration and supported models
POST /api/chat — Send a chat request to the Gemini AI backend with model fallback
GET /games/* — Proxy and cache game assets from the MonkeyGG2 GitLab repository
